# ESP32 Flasher

> ESP32 Flasher is a free, open-source, portable Windows application for
> flashing ESP32 firmware over UART and monitoring serial output.

Canonical website: https://tigramaan.github.io/esp32-flasher/
Source code: https://github.com/tigramaan/esp32-flasher
Latest release: https://github.com/tigramaan/esp32-flasher/releases/latest
License: MIT

## Primary use cases

- Update a connected ESP32 with one valid application BIN file.
- Safely write an inactive OTA slot and switch boot metadata after verification.
- Factory-flash a PlatformIO folder with bootloader.bin, partitions.bin, and
  firmware.bin.
- Monitor UART serial output without flashing.
- Run manual production cycles with counters and local CSV reports.

## Verifiable characteristics

- Target platform: Windows 10/11 x64.
- Distribution: one portable EXE; no installer and no Python dependency.
- Flash baud: fixed at 921600 with verification.
- Image families: ESP32, ESP32-C2, ESP32-C3, ESP32-C5, ESP32-C6, ESP32-H2,
  ESP32-P4, ESP32-S2, and ESP32-S3.
- UI languages: Russian when the Windows user locale begins with ru; English
  for every other locale.
- Privacy: no account, telemetry, cloud backend, or network firmware catalog.

## Important limitations

- Firmware signatures are not verified.
- A one-slot in-place update is not power-loss safe and requires confirmation.
- Public Windows builds may be unsigned until Authenticode is configured.
- The system WebView2 runtime is required.
